fullPassage: In the course of trying to solve a problem with an invention, you may encounter a brick wall of resistance when you try to think your way logically through the problem. Such logical thinking is a linear type of process, which uses our reasoning skills. This works fine when we're operating in the area of what we know or have experienced. However, when we need to deal with new information, ideas, and viewpoints, linear thinking will often come up short. On the other hand, creativity by definition involves the application of new information to old problems and the conception of new viewpoints and ideas. For this you will be most effective if you learn to operate in a nonlinear manner; that is, use your creative brain. Stated differently, if you think in a linear manner, you'll tend to be conservative and keep coming up with techniques which are already known. This, of course, is just what you don't want.

✅ ④ Think Nonlinearly: Unlocking Creative Solutions(비선형적으로 사고하라: 창의적 해결책을 여는 법): 비선형적 사고로 창의적 해결을 한다는 글 전체를 포괄 ← 정답

questions.passage: In the course of trying to solve a problem with an invention, you may encounter <u>a brick wall of resistance</u> when you try to think your way logically through the problem. Such logical thinking is a linear type of process, which uses our reasoning skills. This works fine when we're operating in the area of what we know or have experienced. However, when we need to deal with new information, ideas, and viewpoints, linear thinking will often come up short. On the other hand, creativity by definition involves the application of new information to old problems and the conception of new viewpoints and ideas. For this you will be most effective if you learn to operate in a nonlinear manner; that is, use your creative brain. Stated differently, if you think in a linear manner, you'll tend to be conservative and keep coming up with techniques which are already known. This, of course, is just what you don't want.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 a brick wall of resistance가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② 더 이상의 진전을 막는 강력한 장벽 — brick wall은 넘기 힘든 한계의 비유
det.analysis:
❌ ① a physical wall built to protect an invention(발명품을 보호하는 실제 벽): 실제 벽이 아닌 사고의 한계 비유
✅ ② a strong barrier that blocks further progress(더 이상의 진전을 막는 강력한 장벽): 'brick wall of resistance'는 논리적으로만 생각할 때 부딪히는 '넘기 힘든 한계'를 뜻하는 비유 ← 정답
❌ ③ a helpful guide that speeds up problem-solving(문제 해결을 돕는 안내자): 장벽은 도움이 아닌 방해
❌ ④ a minor error that is quickly and easily fixed(쉽게 고치는 사소한 오류): brick wall은 쉽게 넘는 것이 아님
det.tip: brick wall = 넘기 힘든 벽/한계 (비유). resistance = 저항

questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 This가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:

❌ ② 새로운 정보와 아이디어: 뒤 문장에 나오는 내용으로 This의 선행 지칭 대상이 아님
❌ ③ 창의적인 뇌를 사용하는 것: 글 뒷부분의 내용
